For a Bengaluru → Chennai booking, the real cost is not just the displayed fare. The main differences are cancellation add-ons, non-refundable platform fees, and what happens if the operator cancels.

Option	Total-cost considerations	Cancellation / “warranty”	Support
redBus	Base fare + applicable booking/service/convenience fees. Exact fees appear at checkout.	Standard cancellation follows the individual operator. Free Cancellation can give 100% fare refund if cancelled 6/12+ hours before departure, but add-ons/fees aren't refunded. 
redBus
+1
	24/7 support; live tracking. 
redBus

AbhiBus	Operator fare + possible convenience/service/payment fees. It explicitly charges ₹15 cancellation fee in addition to operator charges under standard cancellation. 
AbhiBus
	Free Cancellation starts around ₹9, usually giving 100% base-fare refund if cancelled ≥6h before departure. Travel Guarantee starts around ₹9 and can provide 3× value if the operator cancels, but 2× is a future-use coupon valid 7 days. 
AbhiBus
+1
	24/7 support; refunds generally go to the original method.
IntrCity SmartBus	Current Bengaluru–Chennai listings show roughly ₹599–₹749+ after displayed discounts, depending on service/seat. 
AbhiBus
	Its Flexi Cancellation reduces penalties; 5-Min Cancellation allows a full refund within 5 minutes of booking, subject to T&Cs. Standard IntrCity examples can charge 15%–100% depending on timing. 
IntrCity
+1
	24/7 support; refunds generally take 3–7 business days. 
IntrCity

What I'd check at checkout: final payable amount, whether convenience/payment fees are refundable, cancellation cutoff, refund amount, and whether any “guarantee” pays cash or only a coupon.

For this route, AbhiBus is particularly worth comparing when cancellation protection matters, because you can see the protection cost separately rather than assuming the headline fare tells you the total risk.

For a first-time handicrafts exporter in Jodhpur, I’d rank onboarding like this:

Option	Onboarding	What to expect
Shiprocket X	⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Easiest	Free signup, company details + KYC, pickup address and wallet. International KYC is typically reviewed in 8–24 hrs. Multiple courier partners. 
Customer Support
+1

DHL Express	⭐⭐⭐⭐	More paperwork, but strong export/customs guidance. Typically requires GSTIN, IEC and AD Code for company exports. MyDHL+ simplifies labels and documentation. 
DHL
+1

FedEx	⭐⭐⭐	Business-account application + PAN, address proof, GSTIN and potentially IEC/LUT/AD documents; a sales rep contacts you. 
FedEx
+1

Best first choice: Shiprocket X for ease and comparing carriers. Choose DHL if reliability and customs support matter more than onboarding simplicity.
